outcome: When the backup creature enters, N +1/+1 counters go on the target creature, which if another gains the abilities printed below backup until end of turn.
A copy of a backup permanent keeps the order of printed abilities, so the same abilities are granted below backup.
Only abilities printed on the backup object are granted, not abilities it gained.
The granted abilities are fixed as the backup ability is put on the stack, even if the source loses abilities before resolution.
